name: EuroHPC Quantum Computing Infrastructure
description: The EuroHPC Joint Undertaking procures and co-funds quantum computers integrated with European supercomputing centres, with its mandate recently expanded to cover quantum simulation, communication, and sensing. It has deployed six quantum systems across Europe, including installations in Poland, Finland, Germany, and the Czech Republic, with additional procurements underway in Italy and the Netherlands.

news.title: EuroHPC Deploys Euro-Q-Exa Quantum Computer in Germany
news.excerpt: The EuroHPC Joint Undertaking unveiled Euro-Q-Exa, a 54-qubit superconducting quantum computer based on IQM's Radiance platform, at the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ) in Germany, supporting hybrid quantum–classical workflows.

news.title: EuroHPC Opens Access to Its Quantum Computers
news.excerpt: EuroHPC announced opening access to its quantum computers for researchers and industry.

news.title: EuroHPC Launches EUR 119M in Quantum Technology Funding Calls
news.excerpt: EuroHPC JU launched six calls totaling EUR 119 million to fund quantum computing, communications, and pilot production across Europe. The call opened 13 August 2026 with an application deadline of 17 November 2026.
